We turn Serotonin Centers into a 10-line Smart-DID grid where every weight-loss, hormone, and wellness inquiry is answered live, booked into a consult, and never lost to voicemail.

insight: a wellness or weight-loss member is worth $2,000–$12,000+ a year in recurring revenue — and the inquiry comes from someone who finally decided to change something, on a lunch break, ready to book if a human answers. A missed call is a member who books the clinic across town. A phone number that just rings can't catch that moment. A Smart DID can.

pillars.p: A compliant dialer works lapsed members and consult no-shows for reactivation — branded caller-ID, consented scripting, recordings. You refill the schedule from patients who already know you.
10 tracked lines + 24/7 live/AI answer + SMS. Every source measured, every program routed, every missed call auto-called-back.
Calls, texts, consults booked, ad spend and source — one live dashboard. You finally see which dollar produced which member.

commandCenter.note: Every call feeds a real-time conduit your customized "second brain" analyzes on the fly — then you, or the AI, adjust the leads, script, offer, program, or channel and watch the schedule fill. You change lives — we make the phone ring.
